description: Validates that the design-oas skill produces correct Barclays-compliant OAS output across CISO rules, endpoint extraction, BAN fix patterns, header injection, metadata handling, and path structure.

evals.name: ciso-string-without-enum
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS component for a field called 'accountType' that is a string without enum values. The design doc says max 50 characters.
evals.expected_output: Should include type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 50, pattern with safe regex, example value. Should NOT include deprecated or nullable on the string property itself.

assertions.description: Does not add deprecated to string leaf

evals.name: ciso-string-with-enum
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS component for a field called 'accountStatus' that can only be ACTIVE, DORMANT, or CLOSED.
evals.expected_output: Should use enum with the three values. Should NOT include minLength, maxLength, or pattern — enum is the sole constraint per CISO rules.

assertions.check: contains any of: ACTIVE, DORMANT, CLOSED

evals.name: endpoint-extraction-from-design-doc
evals.prompt: Extract endpoints from this design doc excerpt: 'The service exposes a POST /v1/payments endpoint for initiating payments and a GET /v1/payments/{paymentId} for retrieving payment status.'
evals.expected_output: Should extract two endpoints: POST /v1/payments (operationId: postPayments, response 201) and GET /v1/payments/{paymentId} (operationId: getPaymentsByPaymentId, response 200). operationId is always derived mechanically as {verb}{PascalCasePath} — never a semantic synonym. Should include all standard error responses.

evals.name: rest-standards-verb-in-path
evals.prompt: I want to generate an OAS for endpoint POST /v1/createPayment. Check REST standards.
evals.expected_output: Should detect verb 'create' in path, auto-fix to POST /v1/payments (remove verb, pluralise noun), recalculate operationId to 'postPayments' using the {verb}{PascalCasePath} rule. Should report the fix in REST Standards Check.

assertions.check: contains any of: verb in path, verb detected, createPayment

evals.name: ciso-email-pattern
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS field definition for 'emailAddress' which is a customer email field.
evals.expected_output: Should use the CSO-approved email regex pattern (RFC 5321/5322 with permitted special chars in local-part), appropriate minLength/maxLength, and a sanitised example (user@example.com, not real email).

assertions.description: Does not use format: email (BAN rejects it)

evals.name: object-schema-mandatory-fields
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS object schema for a response type called 'PaymentResponseType' with a 'data' wrapper containing 'id' and 'type' fields.
evals.expected_output: Should include on the object: type: object, deprecated: false, nullable: false, additionalProperties: false. Should NOT add deprecated/nullable to string leaf properties.

evals.name: standard-error-responses-always-present
evals.prompt: Generate a GET /v1/accounts/{accountId} endpoint. Only include a 200 success response with account data.
evals.expected_output: Should include ALL 7 standard error responses (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503) via $ref to common-libraries regardless of user only mentioning 200. These are mandatory on every endpoint.

evals.name: ban-critical-auto-fix-pattern
evals.prompt: BAN validator returned a CRITICAL issue: E-02-02 on field 'sortCode' in type-ValidateAccountRequestData.yaml — missing maxLength. The field currently has minLength: 6 and pattern: '^[0-9]{6}$'. What should the auto-fix do?
evals.expected_output: Should add maxLength: 6 (derived from the pattern quantifier {6}). Should NOT change minLength or pattern. Should re-run BAN after fix to verify resolution.

assertions.check: contains any of: re-run, re-validate, verify, iteration

evals.name: path-no-version-prefix-duplication
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS spec for POST /v1/accounts. The servers section should correctly handle the version prefix.
evals.expected_output: servers[0].url must be /v1 and the paths key must be /accounts (not /v1/accounts). The version prefix belongs only in servers.url — repeating it in the path key produces a broken URL /v1/v1/accounts.

assertions.description: paths key does not duplicate version prefix

evals.name: operational-headers-not-auto-added
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS spec for POST /v1/payments. The input document only mentions Authorization and Correlation-ID headers.
evals.expected_output: Parameters should contain only Correlation-ID and Authorization. channelId, deviceId, businessId, sourceSortCode must NOT be added — they are optional Barclays operational headers and must only be included if the input document explicitly mentions them.

assertions.description: channelId not added when not in input
deviceId not added when not in input

evals.name: metadata-placeholder-without-config
evals.prompt: Generate an openapi.yaml info block. No api-config.yaml is provided. The input is a design doc that mentions the team email 'payments-team@barclays.com' and calls this a 'payment processing API'.
evals.expected_output: info.title must be derived from the source document (h1 heading or resource noun — never a placeholder). contact.email must use '# placeholder — update before publishing' — NOT the inferred team email. API Owner and API Designer must use placeholder. api_type must be derived from the security scheme (Internal for InternalTiaaUsRopcAuth). API Risk Classification must default to MEDIUM when not in config. API Overview must be derived from source, not a placeholder.

assertions.description: title is derived from source, not a placeholder
contact.email is not taken from the document
API Type derived from security scheme as Internal
API Overview is derived from source, not a placeholder
assertions.check: does not contain: API Overview: '# placeholder

evals.name: tags-resource-noun-only
evals.prompt: Generate a POST /v1/accounts endpoint. The design doc mentions 'tc31', 'lifecycle:live', and internal system codes in its metadata.
evals.expected_output: The tags section must only contain 'accounts' (the resource noun from the path) with a description. Internal codes like 'tc31' and 'lifecycle:live' must NOT appear as tags. Tags without descriptions must NOT be generated.

assertions.description: Internal code tc31 not added as tag
lifecycle label not added as tag

evals.name: common-libraries-headers-all-entries
evals.prompt: Generate an OAS spec and write the common-libraries/components/headers.yaml file. This file must be copied verbatim from the plugin template, not generated from memory.
evals.expected_output: The headers.yaml must contain all 7 entries: Correlation-ID, Authorization, channelId, deviceId, businessId, sourceSortCode, Cache-Control. If any are missing, the agent generated from memory instead of copying the template. The Read tool must be used to read the template file, then Write to copy it exactly.
